units.source_text: 无奈神甫的疑虑虽然解除了，但是流传在众教人之间的留言并没有减少的迹象，

en.t: Although the priest's doubts had been cleared away, the rumors spreading among the believers showed no sign of diminishing,

units.source_text: 西美昂和罗连情同手足，自然对这件事就更加介怀。

en.t: Since Simeon and Lorenzo were as close as brothers, he naturally took the matter even more to heart.

units.source_text: 刚开始听到这个丑事的时候，自己都觉得羞愧难当，

en.t: When he first heard of this disgraceful affair, he himself felt unbearably ashamed,

units.source_text: 本来想厉声询问，但是每次看到罗连的脸，就觉得难以置信。

en.t: He had meant to question him sternly, but every time he saw Lorenzo's face, he found it hard to believe.

units.source_text: 有一天，在圣鲁卡教堂的后园里，见到了那个女子写给罗连的情书，

en.t: One day, in the back garden of the Church of Saint Luke, he found a love letter that the woman had written to Lorenzo,

units.source_text: 趁着屋里没人，把情书扔到了罗连面前，连哄带诱，再次反复询问，

en.t: and when no one was in the house, he threw it down before Lorenzo and questioned him again and again, coaxing and pressing him by turns,

units.source_text: 罗连面红耳赤，厉声回答：“这个女子虽然对我有心，

en.t: Lorenzo flushed red in the face and ears and answered sharply, "This woman may have feelings for me,

units.source_text: 但是我只是收了情书，但是从未答复过她。”

en.t: but I only received her letters and have never once answered her."

units.source_text: 但是西美昂仍然不相信，一直反复追问，

en.t: But Simeon still did not believe him and kept pressing him with repeated questions,

units.source_text: 罗连生气的说：“你以为我是会欺骗上帝的人吗？”

en.t: Lorenzo said angrily, "Do you think I am the sort of man who would deceive God?"

units.source_text: 说完，愤而离去，就像受惊了鸟儿一般。

en.t: With that, he left in anger, like a startled bird.

units.source_text: 西美昂非常后悔自己的多疑，沮丧的想要出去，

en.t: Simeon deeply regretted his own suspiciousness and, dejected, was about to go out,

units.source_text: 忽然看见罗连匆忙的折返回来，并一头扑进了西美昂的，

en.t: when he suddenly saw Lorenzo hurry back and fling himself straight toward Simeon,

units.source_text: 搂住他的腰，气喘吁吁的地生活：“是我不好！”

en.t: clutched him around the waist, and gasped, "It is my fault!"

units.source_text: 西美昂还没来记得回答，罗连已经捂着流泪的脸，又快速的跑了。

en.t: Before Simeon could even answer, Lorenzo had already covered his tearful face and quickly run off again.

units.source_text: 而“是我不好”的低语，终究不知道具体是什么意思，到底是承认自己和女子有染，自知有罪呢，

en.t: As for the whispered words "It is my fault," no one ever knew exactly what they meant: whether he was admitting that he had been involved with the woman and knew his own guilt,

units.source_text: 还是因为自己对西美昂语气不好，而深表抱歉呢？

en.t: or whether he was deeply apologizing because he had spoken harshly to Simeon.
